summary: Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass, including a NEW dedicated regression test (test_otp_request_repeat_after_verify_no_500_regression) that exercises 3 request→verify cycles for the SAME phone+role across all 3 mobile roles (customer/restaurant/delivery) — previously produced a 500 DuplicateKeyError, now returns 200 every time. Existing cooldown-429 test still passes, so the fix is scoped and non-regressive. Frontend: Admin Web fully functional via Partner→Admin→admin-login on wide viewport — Dashboard shows real counts (7 orders today, ₹1048 revenue, ₹28 platform revenue, ₹28 delivery margin, ₹880 seller payable, ₹112 partner payable, 13 customers, 2 restaurants); Settings screen renders TWO SEPARATE brand cards ('Customer Delivery Charge' with delivery_base_first_km + delivery_additional_per_km, and 'Delivery Partner Earning' with 3km→₹28, 4→₹35, 5→₹42 slabs); Save Settings shows 'Settings saved. Applies to future orders.' toast (PUT /api/admin/settings 200 OK); Service Areas, Settlements (Restaurant-wise ₹880 Spice Route Kitchen 4 orders + Delivery Partner-wise), Restaurants list (Spice Route Kitchen visible), Orders list all load. Partner phone-login screens render correctly for both Restaurant Partner and Delivery Partner branding. Full end-to-end 4-app state machine (customer place COD order → restaurant accept→preparing→ready → delivery accept-with-₹28-earning→pickup→start→deliver → DELIVERED + admin settlement includes it) is proven server-side. Deprecated RN warnings persist: shadow* → boxShadow, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents, useNativeDriver on web.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicated testID='phone-input' — the same testID appears on the customer /login screen AND on the partner /partner/{role} phone-login screen; both remain mounted in the Expo Router stack, so a Playwright locator resolves to 2 elements (test framework warning). Automation must use .last or scope to the visible screen container.

issues: Admin Orders list row shows only aggregate 'Total ₹X' + distance; the customer_delivery_charge and delivery_partner_earning are only exposed when the row is expanded via admin-order-{id} press. The review-request explicitly asks that both amounts be visible in the orders list — verify with main agent whether expand-to-view meets the requirement or if they need to be surfaced in the collapsed row.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — use 'boxShadow'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/login.tsx and other screens using elevated cards/buttons.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated — use style.pointerEvents. Reference: TouchableOpacity/Pressable usage across screens.
Warning: RCTAnimation missing — Animated falls back to JS animation on web. Wrap useNativeDriver with Platform.OS !== 'web' or use LayoutAnimation.

CLARIFY WITH PM: Admin Orders list — surface customer_delivery_charge AND delivery_partner_earning in the collapsed row (currently only Total + distance shown; both values are visible after expanding).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py otp_request: current fix uses `replace_one` + `update_many({consumed:false},{consumed:true})` before insert — correct. However, the OtpChallenge collection has a unique index on (phone, role, consumed:false). If two /auth/otp/request calls race, the update_many→insert_one is not atomic; recommend a single upsert on (phone, role) or a transaction. Current 60s cooldown makes this unlikely but not impossible.
routes_ops delivery_pickup/start/deliver/location still dereferences partner without None-guard (carried over from iter 1).

rca_of_issue: REGRESSION FIX VERIFICATION — /api/auth/otp/request DuplicateKeyError: root cause was that a previous OTP challenge with same (phone, role, consumed:false) still existed when insert_one ran on a unique compound index; server.py now marks all previous challenges consumed via update_many BEFORE insert_one, and the rate-limit doc uses replace_one with upsert=True. Verified across all 3 mobile roles (customer/restaurant/delivery) with 3 back-to-back request→verify cycles per role: all return 200. Cooldown-429 for repeat WITHOUT verify is preserved.
